evidence_class: local synthetic mechanism tests; pure-Python reference implementation in tools/hyperposition_h6_credit_switch_lab.py

experiments.mechanism: Compare broadcast outcome credit, chosen-path credit, and receipt-gated path credit under skew, distribution shift and 10% constructed reward corruption.
experiments.interpretation: Credit assignment is a distinct topology. Broadcast reward is structurally wrong in this constructed family; even chosen-path credit can concentrate on a frequent context after shift. Receipt-gated uncertain credit materially reduces false reinforcement. Absolute effect sizes are not FRANK estimates.

experiments.mechanism: Compare direct live topology repoint with bounded canary admission and canary plus post-switch rollback health window.
experiments.interpretation: A constructive/versioned topology candidate can still be harmful if made live directly. Bounded pre-release evaluation and rollback reduce constructed blast radius but reject some beneficial updates.

experiments.mechanism: Compare sequential in-place active-topology mutation with off-path version construction plus idealized atomic live-reference switch under injected crash points.
experiments.interpretation: Versioned topology plus atomic live-reference switching avoids partial live states by construction in this model. This is not durable-filesystem or distributed-process proof; it complements, rather than replaces, canary validation because a fully consistent new version can still be wrong.

negative_boundary: No target Qwen, live FRANK, real Android topology placement, durable filesystem crash, real WASI capability red-team or production causal-credit estimator was tested.
